answer: Capacity expires every epoch. meadow gives each verified operator one nontransferable meter; willow counts every identity attached to it. Each attested epoch mints one bankable tundra to that meter; keeping all those identities tradable for one epoch burns tundra equal to the square of their count. Ten clones thus consume 100 attested epochs of minting per trading epoch, the tenth adding 19; an honest newcomer consumes one. Extra keys cannot split the count, add meters, or mint in parallel.
